FIELDS.NAME: Precision Tire and Auto Care
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Precision Tire and Auto Care specializes in providing high-quality tire sales, installation, balancing, and rotation services for passenger vehicles and light trucks. Our operation focuses on basic automotive maintenance such as oil changes, battery replacements, and fluid top-offs, ensuring routine services present minimal liability. We exclusively sell and install new tires sourced from reputable manufacturers, prioritizing product quality and customer safety. Our facilities have a documented safety program, and all technicians are certified and receive regular safety training, which helps reduce workplace accidents and upholds service quality. We maintain minimal inventory of hazardous materials, stored per regulatory guidelines, and we ensure compliance with all environmental and waste disposal regulations. Our centers are designed with a customer waiting area and a clear separation between service bays and public spaces to enhance safety for our clients.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not engage in towing, contract wrecking, or roadside assistance operations, and confirms that no major engine, transmission, or drivetrain repairs are performed. Additionally, we do not service heavy-duty, agricultural, or construction vehicles, nor do we sell or install used, retreaded, or salvaged tires. We are fully committed to maintaining compliance with these standards.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Loss occurred on 02/15/2023 due to an accidental slip and fall in the service area, resulting in a claim of $3,500.00. The claim is currently in the review process.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday 8:00 AM - 6:00 PM; Saturday 8:00 AM - 4:00 PM; Closed on Sunday
